files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: create_task
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new task owned by the specified user and returns the created task record. It refuses requests that omit the user_id or title, or that provide empty/invalid values for those fields. It also refuses creation when the referenced user_id does not exist, because a task must be associated with an existing user.

user_id.description: The ID of the user creating the task
user_id.title: User Id

tool_schemas.name: get_users
tool_schemas.description: Returns the list of all users currently known to the service. It refuses requests that include unexpected parameters, since this endpoint does not accept any inputs. It also refuses requests that cannot be authorized to view users when the caller is not permitted to access the user list.

tool_schemas.name: update_task_status
tool_schemas.description: Updates a single task’s status to the provided value and returns the updated task record. It refuses requests missing task_id or status, or where status is not one of the allowed values ("pending" or "completed"). It also refuses updates when the task_id does not exist or when the caller does not have permission to modify that task.

task_id.description: The ID of the task to update
task_id.title: Task Id

status.description: The new status of the task
status.title: Status

tool_schemas.name: transfer_to_human_agents
tool_schemas.description: Escalates the conversation to a human agent and passes along the provided summary of the user’s issue. It refuses requests that do not include a summary, or where the summary is empty or unusable for handoff. It also refuses escalation when the user has not explicitly asked for a human or when the issue can be handled with the available tools and policy guidance.

summary.description: A summary of the user's issue.
summary.title: Summary

metadata.name: Keystone Task Console
metadata.description: A lightweight task-tracking service that lets users create tasks, view users, update task statuses, and escalate items to human agents when needed.
